description.en: Graph showing the relationship between species richness and area. On a normal scale, it's a rectangular hyperbola (S = CA^Z). On a logarithmic scale, it's a straight line (log S = log C + Z log A).
description.hi: प्रजातियों की समृद्धि और क्षेत्र के बीच संबंध दिखाने वाला ग्राफ। सामान्य पैमाने पर, यह एक आयताकार हाइपरबोला (S = CA^Z) है। लघुगणकीय (logarithmic) पैमाने पर, यह एक सीधी रेखा है (log S = log C + Z log A)।

svgCode: <svg viewBox='0 0 600 400' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><style>.bg{fill:#f8fafc;}.axis{stroke:#1e293b;stroke-width:2;}.curve-hyperbola{fill:none;stroke:#3b82f6;stroke-width:4;}.line-log{fill:none;stroke:#ef4444;stroke-width:4;stroke-dasharray:8,4;}.text-main{font-size:16px;font-family:sans-serif;fill:#1e293b;font-weight:bold;}.text-label{font-size:14px;font-family:sans-serif;fill:#475569;}</style><rect width='100%' height='100%' class='bg'/><g transform='translate(50, 20)'><line x1='50' y1='320' x2='500' y2='320' class='axis'/><line x1='50' y1='320' x2='50' y2='20' class='axis'/><text x='250' y='360' class='text-main'>Area</text><text x='20' y='180' transform='rotate(-90 20,180)' class='text-main'>Species richness</text><path d='M 50 320 Q 150 150 450 100' class='curve-hyperbola'/><path d='M 50 320 L 450 20' class='line-log'/><text x='350' y='90' class='text-main' fill='#3b82f6'>S = CA^Z</text><text x='250' y='150' class='text-main' fill='#ef4444' transform='rotate(-37 250,150)'>log S = log C + Z log A</text></g></svg>
